metric: cover-shadow sigma/lambda discrimination re-tune (GS WC2022, ADR-066)
decision_reason: The pre-registered decide_apply gate returns applied for the measured candidate (all conjuncts pass: coverage>=0.30, receiver_margin>=0.05, ablation<0.50, noise_ok). It is NOT applied: the argmax lambda is boundary-clipped at the grid minimum (1.5) and slides further out as data grows (10-match probe 2.0 -> 64-match 1.5), i.e. an unbounded, boundary-degenerate optimum, not a valid measured argmax. The gain is marginal (+0.0098 margin-AUC) and demands a large, aggressive parameter change (sigma 0.20->0.04, a near-unblurred cover-shadow) whose sigma shift is partly the lane-pressure bias the ablation exists to catch (ablation 0.177, non-zero). Boundary-degeneracy is a validity failure the pre-registered conjuncts do not test; owner decision (reported-not-gated cycle) is to keep the incumbent. No library change.
library_change: none -- _PROVIDER_COVER_SHADOW_PARAMS has no GS entry; CoverShadowParams() unchanged

provenance.note: aggregate statistics only (sigma/lambda/AUC/gain); no raw per-pass GS data (owner-tier)
